text: Refunds are available within 30 days of delivery for items in their original condition. The refund goes back to the original payment method.
Damaged or defective items are refunded in full, including shipping, at any time within the warranty period. Photos are not required for orders under 100 USD.
Refunds are issued once per order. A second request for the same order is declined and the first refund id is quoted back to the customer.
